tickets.title: Prepare Tin Sparrow pre-clearance narrative
tickets.text: Prepare a pre-clearance narrative for Apricot Compass Advisory covering Selene Velvetreed’s proposed sale size, liquidity purpose, account destination, and confirmation that she has no material nonpublic information.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2024-09-06 to prepare pre-clearance narrative covering proposed sale size, liquidity purpose, account destination, and no material nonpublic information to Apricot Compass Advisory.

tickets.title: Prepare before-tax exercise cost and cash-needed scenarios
tickets.text: Provide Selene Velvetreed’s before-tax exercise cost, estimated withholding, and cash-needed scenarios for her vested Tin Sparrow Robotics options. Reflect the $12.40 exercise price and the fact that the options expire soon after the next blackout window.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2024-09-11 to provide before-tax exercise cost, estimated withholding, and cash-needed scenarios because vested options expire soon after the next blackout window.

tickets.title: Reconcile employer vested share counts
tickets.text: Reconcile Velvet Acorn Custody’s 18,200-share feed with the 19,050 vested shares reported by Tin Sparrow Robotics.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2024-09-10 to reconcile Velvet Acorn Custody’s 18,200-share feed with the 19,050 vested shares in the employer report.
